extDescription.message: Translate words on web pages and in video subtitles, save them to your vault and review them with quick quizzes.

popupClose.description: Label of the button that closes the translation popup.

popupBack.description: Label of the button that leaves the language list and returns to the translation.

popupSpeak.description: Label of the button that reads the selected word aloud.

popupSourceLang.description: Tooltip of the source-language control and title of the list that opens from it.

popupTargetLang.description: Tooltip of the target-language control and title of the list that opens from it.

popupTranslating.description: Shown in the translation popup while waiting for the translation.

popupAlternatives.description: Prefix of the list of alternative translations, e.g. 'Also: reservation, volume'.

popupTranslatedBy.description: Attribution line in the translation popup. $1 is the name of the translation service.

popupRetry.description: Button shown under an error message in the translation popup.

langAuto.description: Source-language choice that lets the extension detect the language.

langAutoDetected.description: Source-language label when the language was detected automatically. $1 is a language name.

langSearch.description: Placeholder of the search box above a list of languages.

langNoMatch.description: Shown when the language search finds nothing.

sitePin.message: Always use this language on this site
sitePin.description: Checkbox under the source language: remember the chosen source language for the current website.

noteSameLanguage.message: This text already seems to be in your target language ($1).
noteSameLanguage.description: Small informational note under a translation. $1 is a language name. Followed by links to change the source or target language.

linkChangeSource.description: Link that opens the source-language list.

linkChangeTarget.description: Link that opens the target-language list.

firstRunText.message: Translations are made into $1. Is that the language you want?
firstRunText.description: Asked once, until the user has chosen a target language. $1 is a language name.

firstRunConfirm.description: Button: keep the suggested target language.

firstRunChange.description: Button: open the list to pick another target language.

speakNoRecording.description: Shown briefly when the pronounce button finds nothing to play.

speakCredit.description: Link under the translation to the recording that was played (author and licence are on the linked page).

optTtsFallback.message: Use the browser voice when a word has no recording
optTtsFallback.description: Options page: switch, only shown in Firefox-based browsers on macOS.

optTtsFallbackHelp.message: In this browser the built-in voice ends every word with a loud click, so Wordvault plays recordings from Wikimedia Commons instead. Turn this on to hear the built-in voice, click included, for words that have no recording.
optTtsFallbackHelp.description: Options page: explanation of the switch above.

vaultAdd.description: Button in the translation popup: save the word.

vaultAddUntranslated.description: Button shown instead of "Add to vault" when no translation is available.

vaultSaved.description: Button label when the word is already saved. Clicking it removes the word.

vaultAdded.description: Short confirmation after saving a word.

vaultRemoved.description: Short confirmation after removing a word.

vaultError.description: Shown when writing to the vault failed.

tbCount.description: Toolbar popup: number of saved words. $1 is a number other than 1.

tbCountOne.description: Toolbar popup: shown when exactly one word is saved.

tbTarget.description: Toolbar popup: shows the target language and opens the list to change it. $1 is a language name.

tbSearch.description: Toolbar popup: placeholder of the search box.

tbAllLanguages.description: Toolbar popup: first entry of the language filter.

tbEmptyTitle.description: Toolbar popup: shown when the vault is empty.

tbEmptyHint.message: Double-click a word on any page, then press “Add to vault”.
tbEmptyHint.description: Toolbar popup: hint under "No words yet".

tbNoMatch.description: Toolbar popup: the search or filter left nothing to show.

tbDelete.description: Toolbar popup: tooltip of the trash button of a word.

tbDeleteConfirm.description: Toolbar popup: the trash button after its first click; a second click deletes the word.

tbSettings.description: Toolbar popup: tooltip of the button that opens the options page.

tbExport.description: Button: download the vault as a JSON file.

tbImport.description: Button: add the words from a JSON backup file.

dtNoTranslation.description: Shown in place of the translation for a word saved without one.

dtMeanings.description: Word details: heading above word types and definitions.

dtMeaningsSource.description: Word details: small note after the "Meanings" heading.

dtLoadingDictionary.description: Word details: shown while Wiktionary is being queried.

dtNoDictionary.message: Wiktionary has no entry for this word.

dtDictionaryError.message: Could not load dictionary data. It will be tried again next time.
dtDictionaryError.description: Word details: the Wiktionary request failed.

dtExamples.description: Word details: heading above the example sentences.

dtYourSentence.message: from the page you saved it on
dtYourSentence.description: Word details: marks the example sentence that comes from the page the word was saved on.

dtSavedFrom.description: Word details: heading above the sentence and page the word was saved from.

bkTitle.description: Options page: heading of the export/import section.

bkHelp.message: Download your vault as a JSON file, or add the words from a file exported on another device. Importing never overwrites words you already have.
bkHelp.description: Options page: explanation of export and import.

bkExported.description: Shown after exporting. $1 is a number.

bkImported.message: Added $1 words. $2 were already in your vault, $3 could not be read.
bkImported.description: Shown after importing. $1, $2 and $3 are numbers.

bkBadFile.message: This file is not a Wordvault backup.
bkBadFile.description: Shown when the chosen file cannot be imported.

syncIntro.message: Keep the vault the same on all your devices. Nothing leaves this browser until you choose one of the ways below and confirm it.

syncModeOffHelp.message: Nothing is connected. Exporting above is your backup.
syncModeOffHelp.description: Options page, synchronisation: explanation of the choice.

syncModeBrowserHelp.message: Uses your browser's own sync. Small: about 100 KB, for lists of up to a few thousand words.
syncModeBrowserHelp.description: Options page, synchronisation: explanation of the choice.

syncModeCloudHelp.message: Google Drive, OneDrive or Dropbox: one file in the app's own folder in your account.
syncModeCloudHelp.description: Options page, synchronisation: explanation of the choice.

syncModeServerHelp.message: WebDAV (Nextcloud, ownCloud …) or a simple HTTP endpoint you run yourself.
syncModeServerHelp.description: Options page, synchronisation: explanation of the choice.

syncServerType.description: Options page, synchronisation: label of the choice between WebDAV and the HTTP endpoint.

syncInUse.description: Options page, synchronisation: badge on the choice that is active.

syncOffExplain.message: The vault stays in this browser only. To have it on another device as well, choose one of the ways above.
syncOffExplain.description: Options page, synchronisation: shown while nothing is connected.

syncBrowserName.description: Name of a place the vault can be synchronised with.

syncGdriveName.description: Name of a place the vault can be synchronised with.

syncOnedriveName.description: Name of a place the vault can be synchronised with.

syncDropboxName.description: Name of a place the vault can be synchronised with.

syncBrowserWhere.message: In your browser's sync storage, which travels with your browser account (Firefox Sync, Chrome sync) like bookmarks do.
syncBrowserWhere.description: Options page, synchronisation: where the data ends up.

syncGdriveWhere.message: In the hidden app data folder of your Google Drive. It does not show among your files; you can see and delete it in Drive under Settings → Manage apps → Wordvault.
syncGdriveWhere.description: Options page, synchronisation: where the data ends up.

syncOnedriveWhere.message: In your OneDrive, in the folder Apps → Wordvault, as the file wordvault-vault.json.gz.
syncOnedriveWhere.description: Options page, synchronisation: where the data ends up.

syncDropboxWhere.message: In your Dropbox, in the folder Apps → Wordvault, as the file wordvault-vault.json.gz.
syncDropboxWhere.description: Options page, synchronisation: where the data ends up.

syncBrowserExplain.message: Your browser carries the vault to your other devices signed in to the same browser account, compressed. There is room for about 100 KB; how full it is will be shown here. When it is full, synchronisation stops and the vault stays whole on this device.
syncBrowserExplain.description: Options page, synchronisation: explanation of browser sync before it is turned on.

syncSetupMissing.description: Options page, synchronisation: badge on a cloud provider whose developer configuration has not been filled in.

syncSetupMissingText.message: Developer setup is missing for this provider: no client ID has been entered yet. Follow the steps in SETUP-OAUTH.md (in the repository), put the ID into src/sync/config.js and build again.
syncSetupMissingText.description: Options page, synchronisation: shown when the user tries to connect a provider that is not configured.

syncNotAvailable.message: This way of synchronising is not part of this version.
syncNotAvailable.description: Options page, synchronisation: shown for a provider that does not exist in this build.

syncTurnOn.description: Options page, synchronisation: button that starts browser sync.

syncContinue.description: Options page, synchronisation: button that confirms connecting.

syncConfirmTitle.description: Options page, synchronisation: heading of the confirmation. $1 is the provider name.

syncConfirmWhat.message: Your saved words will be sent to $1: each word with its translation, its language pair, a short context sentence and your review progress. Page addresses, settings, API keys and sign-in data are never sent.
syncConfirmWhat.description: Options page, synchronisation: what is sent. $1 is the provider name.

syncConfirmWhere.description: Options page, synchronisation: where the data ends up. $1 is a sentence.

syncConfirmMerge.message: If a Wordvault file is already there, it is merged with this vault. No word is lost on either side.
syncConfirmMerge.description: Options page, synchronisation: what happens to existing data.

syncConfirmReplace.message: The connection to $1 that is in use now is dropped. What it has stored stays where it is.
syncConfirmReplace.description: Options page, synchronisation: shown when another provider is connected. $1 is its name.

syncStateWaiting.description: Options page, synchronisation: status. $1 is the reason.

syncStateError.description: Options page, synchronisation: status. $1 is the reason.

syncUsage.description: Options page, synchronisation: label of the storage meter.

syncUsageValue.description: Options page, synchronisation: storage use. $1 percent, $2 used KB, $3 total KB.

syncUsageWarning.message: Almost full. When it is full, synchronisation stops and the vault stays on this device. A cloud account or your own server has room for more.
syncUsageWarning.description: Options page, synchronisation: warning at 80% of the browser sync storage.

syncDisconnectTitle.description: Options page, synchronisation: heading. $1 is the provider name.

syncDisconnectNote.message: The vault on this device stays as it is. It is no longer kept in step with your other devices.

syncDeleteRemote.description: Options page, synchronisation: checkbox, off by default.

syncDeleteRemoteHelp.message: Your other devices keep their own copies, but can no longer exchange them through it.
syncDeleteRemoteHelp.description: Options page, synchronisation: explanation of the checkbox.

syncDisconnected.message: Disconnected. What was stored there has been left in place.

syncDisconnectedDeleted.message: Disconnected, and the stored file was deleted.

syncErrAuth.message: access was withdrawn or has expired; connect again

syncErrQuota.message: there is no room left there; the vault stays whole on this device

syncErrConflict.message: another device kept writing at the same time

syncErrIncomplete.message: the stored copy is still arriving

syncErrBadDocument.message: what is stored there is not a Wordvault file; it was left untouched

syncErrNewerSchema.message: what is stored there was written by a newer version of Wordvault; update this one

syncErrPermission.message: the browser did not give access to that address

syncErrInsecure.message: the address has to start with https:// (http:// is only accepted for localhost)

syncErrUrl.message: this is not a usable address

syncErrPassword.message: the stored file is encrypted and the password is needed

syncIcloudNote.message: iCloud is not offered: a browser extension has no way of reaching iCloud Drive. Export the vault as JSON above and save the file into your iCloud Drive folder instead.
syncIcloudNote.description: Options page, synchronisation: note about iCloud.

quizTitle.description: Title of the small quiz card shown on pages.

quizPrompt.description: Line under the quizzed word. $1 is a language name.

quizWrong.message: Not this one. The right answer is marked.
quizWrong.description: Quiz feedback after a wrong choice.

quizUnknown.description: Quiz card: button for giving up on the question. Counts as a wrong answer.

quizUnknownHint.message: Counts as a wrong answer; the right one is shown
quizUnknownHint.description: Tooltip of the 'I don't know' button.

quizLater.description: Quiz card: button that postpones the question without counting it.

quizLaterHint.message: Doesn't count; the word comes back in a few minutes

quizProgress.description: Quiz: number of the question on screen ($1) out of the questions this quiz asks ($2).

quizMute.description: Quiz: button that switches the quiz off until tomorrow.

quizClose.description: Quiz: button that closes the quiz.

quizSummary.description: Quiz: summary at the end of a quiz with several questions. $1 right answers out of $2 answered questions.

quizSummarySkipped.description: Quiz summary: number of questions postponed with "Ask later".

quizNotificationTitle.description: Title of the system notification that stands in for a quiz.

quizNotificationText.message: Click to answer a question about one of your words.
quizNotificationText.description: Text of the system notification that stands in for a quiz.

optQuizTitle.description: Options page: heading of the quiz section.

optQuizHelp.message: From time to time Wordvault asks you about saved words: in the popup of its toolbar button, in a small window, or as a card on the page. Every word in the vault gets its turn; the ones you get wrong come back sooner.
optQuizHelp.description: Options page: what the quiz is.

optQuizEnabled.description: Options page: the main quiz switch.

optQuizEnabledHelp.message: While this is off no quiz appears and the timer does not run.
optQuizEnabledHelp.description: Options page: explanation of the main quiz switch.

optQuizInterval.description: Options page: label of the quiz frequency setting.

optQuizIntervalHelp.message: A quiz comes this often while you browse. A change counts from the moment you make it.
optQuizIntervalHelp.description: Options page: explanation of the quiz frequency setting.

optQuizIntervalCustom.description: Options page: accessible name of the custom frequency field.

optQuizQuestions.description: Options page: label of the setting for how many questions one quiz asks.

optQuizQuestionsHelp.message: With more than one, the next question follows in the same place and a short summary comes at the end.

quizQuestionsMany.description: Value of the questions-per-quiz setting. $1 is a number greater than 1.

optQuizDisplay.description: Options page: label of the setting for the way a quiz is shown.

optQuizDisplayHelp.message: If the way you choose is not possible at that moment, the next one is used. The panel below says which one it was and why.

quizDisplayAuto.description: A way of showing the quiz: whichever works first.

quizDisplayPopup.description: A way of showing the quiz: the popup under the extension's toolbar button.

quizDisplayWindow.description: A way of showing the quiz: a small window of its own.

quizDisplayCard.description: A way of showing the quiz: a card in the corner of the page.

quizDisplayNotification.description: A way of showing the quiz: a notification that opens the quiz when clicked.

optQuizNotify.message: System notification as a last resort
optQuizNotify.description: Options page: label of the notification permission row.

optQuizNotifyHelp.message: Only when none of the ways above can show a quiz, Wordvault tells you with a notification; clicking it opens the quiz. This needs the browser's notification permission.

optQuizNotifyAllow.description: Options page: button that asks for the notification permission.

optQuizNotifyRemove.description: Options page: button that gives the notification permission back.

optQuizNotifyAllowed.description: Options page: state of the notification permission.

optQuizNotifyDenied.message: the browser did not grant the permission
optQuizNotifyDenied.description: Options page: shown when the notification permission was not granted.

optQuizNotifyTry.description: Options page: button that sends the quiz notification right now.

optQuizNotifySent.message: sent; click it to open the quiz
optQuizNotifySent.description: Options page: shown after the test notification was sent.

quizEveryMinutes.description: Quiz frequency. $1 is a number of minutes greater than 1.

quizEveryHours.description: Quiz frequency. $1 is a number of hours greater than 1.

quizEveryTesting.description: Quiz frequency that is only offered while the extension is loaded for development.

quizEveryCustom.description: Quiz frequency: lets the user type a number of minutes.

optQuizAllowNotDue.message: Also ask words that are not due yet

optQuizAllowNotDueHelp.message: When no word is due for review, the hardest one is asked anyway. Off: no quiz until a word is due.
optQuizAllowNotDueHelp.description: Options page: explanation of the switch.

optQuizMinCards.description: Options page: label of the minimum number of saved words.

optQuizMinCardsHelp.message: The quiz starts once the vault holds this many words.

optQuizTimeout.description: Options page: label of the answer timeout.

optQuizTimeoutHelp.message: A card nobody answers closes after this long and does not count.
optQuizTimeoutHelp.description: Options page: explanation of the answer timeout.

quizDiagTitle.description: Options page: heading of the diagnostics panel.

quizVerdictYes.message: Nothing stands in the way. Next quiz: $1

quizDiagAskableValue.message: $1 words with a translation into $2; $3 different meanings (at least $4 needed)
quizDiagAskableValue.description: Diagnostics value. $1 count, $2 language name, $3 distinct translations, $4 minimum.

quizDiagAlarm.description: Diagnostics row label. The browser alarm that wakes the extension up for the next quiz.

quizDiagAlarmMissing.description: Diagnostics value: the quiz is on but no alarm exists.

quizDiagLastSkip.description: Diagnostics row label. Followed by a time and the reason.

quizDiagLastAnswer.description: Diagnostics row label: what became of the most recent quiz question.

quizOutcomeRight.description: What became of a quiz question.

quizOutcomeWrong.description: What became of a quiz question.

quizOutcomeUnknown.description: What became of a quiz question.

quizOutcomeLater.description: What became of a quiz question.

quizOutcomeTimeout.message: not answered in time, skipped (does not count)
quizOutcomeTimeout.description: What became of a quiz question.

quizOutcomeClosed.description: What became of a quiz question.

quizWhyBelowMinCards.message: the vault holds $1 words, the quiz starts at $2

quizWhyNotEnoughChoices.message: only $4 different meanings in $3; four are needed for the choices

quizWhyWindowNotFocused.message: the browser window was not in front

quizWhyFullscreen.message: the page was in full screen

quizWhyAlreadyShowing.message: a quiz was already on screen

quizWhyPageNotSupported.message: extensions cannot show anything on the page that was open (a browser page, a new tab, or a tab opened before the extension was loaded)

quizDiagDue.description: Diagnostics row label: number of words that are due (new words included).

quizWhyNothingDue.message: no word is due for review yet

quizDiagDisplay.message: Ways of showing it, in order

quizShownAfter.description: How a quiz was shown ($1) and the ways that were tried first, with reasons ($2).

quizUnmute.description: Options page: button that takes "Not today" back.

quizTestShown.description: Options page: result of the test button. $1 is the way the quiz was shown.

quizWhyMuted.message: switched off until tomorrow with “Not today”

quizWhyNoDisplay.message: none of the ways of showing it worked

quizWhyPopupUnsupported.message: this browser cannot open the toolbar popup by itself
quizWhyPopupUnsupported.description: Reason one way of showing the quiz was not possible.

quizWhyPopupRefused.message: the browser refused to open it
quizWhyPopupRefused.description: Reason one way of showing the quiz was not possible.

quizWhyPopupNotOpened.description: Reason one way of showing the quiz was not possible.

quizWhyWindowUnsupported.message: this browser cannot open windows for extensions
quizWhyWindowUnsupported.description: Reason one way of showing the quiz was not possible.

quizWhyWindowRefused.message: the browser refused to open it
quizWhyWindowRefused.description: Reason one way of showing the quiz was not possible.

quizWhyWindowNotOpened.description: Reason one way of showing the quiz was not possible.

quizWhyNotificationNotAllowed.description: Reason one way of showing the quiz was not possible.

quizWhyNotificationRefused.message: the browser did not show it
quizWhyNotificationRefused.description: Reason one way of showing the quiz was not possible.

quizTest.description: Options page: button that shows a quiz immediately.

quizTestHelp.message: Shows a quiz right now the way the timer would, skipping the timer and every condition above. The line below says how it was shown.
quizTestHelp.description: Options page: explanation of the test button.

quizTestFailed.message: The background script did not answer. Reload the extension.
quizTestFailed.description: Options page: shown when the test button gets no reply.

optTargetLang.description: Options page: heading of the target-language setting.

optTargetLangHelp.message: Translations are made into this language. You can also change it from the translation popup.
optTargetLangHelp.description: Options page: explanation under the target-language heading.

optTargetLangCurrent.description: Options page: shows the selected target language. $1 is a language name.

optTargetLangUnset.message: Not chosen yet. Using your browser's language: $1
optTargetLangUnset.description: Options page: shown until the user picks a target language. $1 is a language name.

optDoubleClick.description: Options page: label of the switch for the double-click trigger.

optDoubleClickHelp.message: Double-clicking a word on a page opens the translation popup.
optDoubleClickHelp.description: Options page: explanation of the double-click switch.

optSaved.description: Options page: confirmation shown briefly after a setting is stored.

errNetwork.message: Could not reach the translation service. Check your internet connection.
errNetwork.description: Error: the request failed before any response arrived.

errTimeout.message: The translation service took too long to respond.

errRateLimit.message: The translation service's free limit has been reached. Try again later.
errRateLimit.description: Error: the provider refused the request because of a usage quota.

errUnsupportedLanguage.message: The translation service does not support this language pair. Try picking the languages above.
errUnsupportedLanguage.description: Error: the provider rejected the source or target language.

errTooLong.message: The selected text is too long to translate.
errTooLong.description: Error: the selection exceeds the length limit.

errNoResult.description: Error: the provider returned an empty result.

errContextInvalidated.message: Wordvault was updated. Reload this page to keep using it.
errContextInvalidated.description: Error: the extension was reloaded or updated while this page stayed open.
